motivation: In the sealed first 256 training roots, among 265 same-rank pairs with observed T9/T12 EOT, absolute log-growth gap averaged 0.315 per eligible source. Among ordered rank pairs, stronger growth agreed with better placement 59% of the time. The terminal-only gradient cannot distinguish equal-rank growth.
training: Reuse the four existing simulator rollout batches of each group-relative arm, keeping the independent roots separate. From pairs at the same opening prefer the path with observed common T9-to-T12 growth advantage >0.10 and no worse final rank; if either growth is unobserved, use strict rank ordering only. No pair prefers worse placement. No card or tribe teacher. One vote per root (average comparisons).
network: Full v1.4-r1 actor initialized separately for both disjoint data splits. Pair logistic loss at temperature coefficient 0.5 on path action log-likelihood ratio vs frozen initial parent, each path sum divided by sqrt(sampled choices). Reference log probabilities recomputed at sampling temperature 0.75 for all iterations. Sampled log-ratio square penalty 0.025. Two fixed epochs, eight roots per update, AdamW 5e-6, clip gradient 0.5.
test: Compare all prespecified candidates on the same 256 v14hold game seeds as the online group-relative policy. The parent games are reused exactly once. This exploratory same-panel comparison requires a new independent 512-seed confirmation before any long-training recommendation.
